title.en: Exercise Hosting Coordination Framework in Qatar
title.zh: 卡塔尔签署 INSARAG 演习主办协调框架协议

summary.en: On 2 June 2026 an Exercise Hosting Coordination Framework between Lekhwiya and INSARAG was signed in preparation for the INSARAG Global Exercise (Qatar, 25 to 29 October 2026). The arrangement was signed by Ambassador Dominik Stillhart, INSARAG Global Chair, and Staff Brigadier Mubarak Sherida Al Kaabi, Assistant Commander for Administration and Supply.
summary.zh: 2026年6月2日，卡塔尔国内安全部队（Lekhwiya）与 INSARAG 签署演习主办协调框架协议，为2026年10月25日至29日在卡塔尔举行的 INSARAG 全球演习做筹备。

content.en: On 2 June 2026 an Exercise Hosting Coordination Framework between Lekhwiya and INSARAG was signed in preparation for the INSARAG Global Exercise (Qatar, 25 to 29 October 2026). The arrangement was signed by Ambassador Dominik Stillhart, INSARAG Global Chair, and Staff Brigadier Mubarak Sherida Al Kaabi, Assistant Commander for Administration and Supply.
content.zh: 2026年6月2日，卡塔尔国内安全部队（Lekhwiya）与 INSARAG 签署演习主办协调框架协议，为将于2026年10月25日至29日在卡塔尔举行的 INSARAG 全球演习做最后筹备。该协议由 INSARAG 全球主席多米尼克·斯蒂尔哈特大使与主管行政与后勤的助理指挥官穆巴拉克·沙里达·卡比准将共同签署。
